check_on_pr: create a check run on a GitHub pull request with a name, markdown summary, and success status
jwt_token: generate a JWT token using a GitHub App private key with RS256 algorithm and 10 minute expiry
access_token: fetch and cache a GitHub API access token with retry logic for up to 6 attempts
call: make an authenticated HTTP request to the GitHub API with bearer token authorization headers
latest_commit: retrieve the latest commit from a GitHub pull request using the Kokoro environment variable
